text:
Jordan: Heads-up — thinking about switching model pin schema to "lease-slices" where a pin is composed of multiple short leases that can be revoked independently. Pros/cons? TL;DR: better eviction granularity, harder rollback reasoning.

Sophie: Can you sketch the API surface? how would clients pin a model?

Jordan: Rough sketch:
```
PATCH /pins/{pin_id}
{
  "add_slices": [{"lease_id":"s1","expires_at":1760000000,"priority":10}],
  "remove_slices": ["s-old"]
}
```
Clients still call GET /pins/{pin_id} -> returns active slices.

Ranjit: Concern: client-surface explosion and mismatch with telemetry; how do we attribute cost to a model if sliced? :thinking_face:

Keegan: Slices could help canary rollouts — remove high-priority slice to drain. But we need atomic "cohort" semantics so partial removal doesn't create unfair capacity drops.

Marta: Ops note: recycling slices increases KV/cache churn. We should measure prefix cache thrash before adopting many small slices. +1 to bounded slice count per pin.

pin-manager-bot: pin-manager: created slice s1 for pin p-abc123 (expires=1760000000)

Sophie: Alternative: single TTL + delegation flag (clients opt into soft-evict). Simpler surface, less churn.

Jordan: Tradeoffs: delegation simpler but leaks operator intent into client flow. Slices give ops control without changing client code. Migration: start with TTL, auto-backfill slices for long-lived pins.

Ranjit: Schema suggestion: keep metadata minimal: ["slice_id","creation_ts","expires_at","priority","owner"]. Avoid large blobs.

Keegan: Also add observational counters: last_seen_ts, eviction_count but keep them optional to avoid RPC noise.

Marta: I can run a staging sim to measure cache hit variance if we flip to slice-heavy strategy.

Jordan: Great — I'll draft a short RFC with protobuf examples and a migration plan. cc @Sophie @Ranjit @Marta :memo: 

Sophie: SGTM. add a small data-retention/cleanup play and a 'replay' tool to map existing pins -> slices. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Filed draft RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/drafts/1754321999-lease-slices (WIP)
